rv.q: But it also tells the story of Mrs Pat, an actor of immense talent who was Shaw’s match when it came to wit and determination, but suffered far more than he did as her star dimmed as she grew older, and personal tragedies affected her in ways Shaw never experienced.

Rachel Pickup and Alan Turkington star as Campbell and Shaw. Many of their letters are read verbatim, with brief moments of exposition bridging gaps and moving the story forward. Between World Wars, loves lost and found, career highs and lows, the pair write back and forth, maintaining a connection rooted in deep affection.
